title: FBI IC3 AI-enabled fraud losses
text: FBI IC3 reported $893M in AI-enabled fraud losses in 2025, driven by voice cloning, deepfake video calls, and LLM-drafted phishing at scale.

title: India digital arrest scam surge
text: Indian cybercrime units report surge in 'digital arrest' scams: victims kept on marathon video calls with deepfake officials while coerced into UPI transfers.

title: NPCI UPI collect-request abuse
text: NPCI advisories warn of collect-request confusion attacks where victims authorize debits believing they are receiving refunds; QR overlay at merchant POS is rising.

title: Agentic checkout attack surface
text: Shopping agents with stored payment tokens create new fraud surface: prompt injection in merchant listings can trigger unauthorized gift-card purchases without step-up auth.

title: Synthetic identity KYC bypass
text: GAN-generated faces and AI-edited documents increasingly pass remote liveness checks; bust-out follows dormancy period on newly onboarded wallet accounts.
